mapper.select: SELECT 1 AS n FROM sksp_secrets WHERE ref = #{ref} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sksp_secrets (ref, ciphertext, iv, algo, version, updated_at_ms) VALUES (#{ref}, #{ciphertext}, #{iv}, #{algo}, 1, #{updatedAtMs}) ON CONFLICT(ref) DO UPDATE SET ciphertext = excluded.ciphertext, iv = excluded.iv, algo = excluded.algo, version = excluded.version, updated_at_ms = excluded.updated_at_ms
